name: Elena Martínez Ruiz
headline: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8 years of experience building and deploying machine learning models for business-critical applications. Skilled in end-to-end ML pipeline development, from data extraction and feature engineering to model deployment and monitoring. Strong background in SQL, Python, and cloud-based ML infrastructure, with experience mentoring junior data scientists and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

responsibilities: Lead development of predictive models for customer churn and demand forecasting
Design and maintain ML pipelines using Python and Airflow
Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production using Docker and AWS SageMaker
Mentor junior data scientists on best practices in model development and evaluation
Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders
Developed machine learning models for fraud detection and risk scoring
Built ETL pipelines to consolidate data from multiple internal systems
Performed exploratory data analysis and statistical testing to support product decisions
Optimized SQL queries for large-scale data extraction and reporting
Analyzed client datasets to identify trends and business opportunities
Built dashboards and reports using SQL and visualization tools
Assisted senior analysts in developing early-stage predictive models
